subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘WATER’ is written as ‘RETAW’, ‘CERTAIN’ is written as ‘NIATREC’, and ‘GENERAL’ is written as ‘LARENEG’. How will ‘LOVELY’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

**Logic : Letters are written in reverse order.**

So,

 
• ‘WATER’ is written as ‘RETAW’

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecd353899daa7eb20a350cab0ec423d4fd05dd3b5fa3453c2563244aa33ea584.png] 

 
• ‘CERTAIN’ is written as ‘NIATREC’

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e483fe6a93971a6bc6cd7b04e4f624b7dccfa3142c115ae478f4ec1e661327.png] 

​And,

 
• ‘GENERAL’ is written as ‘LARENEG’

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7ac466d7cc5db0bc518b6aab3774a090dc26fc84f4662787fb0d07744d1c0ed.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘LOVELY’ is written as

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7756db2a23b2dc5db3323fb6a6a71ba8d8fedfee5091fb348f69d4ce2371a36b.png] 

​Hence, **"YLEVOL"** is the correct answer.
